## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is a Dūnhuáng-preserved Buddhist commentary on the *[Śrīmālā-siṃha-nāda-sūtra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0045)* by an unidentified *Zhāo fǎshī* ("Master Zhāo"). The work is one of several pre-Tang and Tang fragmentary *Śrīmālā* commentaries preserved at Dūnhuáng.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (500 – 900) reflects the broad pre-Tang to Tang period during which the work could have been composed.

The Taishō text (T2762) is established on the Dūnhuáng manuscript witness.
